subject: Private VPC architecture review - scheduling technical deep dive

Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for taking the discovery call today. Quick recap of what I heard:
- You want a Private/VPC deployment (VPC peering or VPC endpoint) for inference workloads
- Strong requirements around KMS integration and customer-managed keys, audit logs (retention 2+ years), and SOC2 evidence
- Expected steady-state throughput ~800 reqs/min with occasional bursts; latency target ~150ms P50 for short prompts
- Compliance and data residency concerns for EU customers (we discussed options)

Next step: schedule a technical architecture review / demo with our SE to align on networking, security, and integration patterns. Marissa (CC'd) will run the deep dive and can bring our deployment engineer.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed Mar 22, 10:00-11:00am
- Wed Mar 22, 2:00-3:00pm
- Thu Mar 23, 9:00-10:00am

If none of these work, share a couple of slots that do. Also please confirm who from your side will join (security, infra, procurement) so we include the right folks on our side.

I'll attach a short pre-read and an agenda once we lock time.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
